title: Migraine Prevention Allowance on First-Time Quantity Limit Exceptions
content:
A member on migraine prevention receives a preventive allowance added to the approval ceiling of a first-time quantity limit exception approved on an acute migraine drug under the Utilization Management Program.

**Rule.** A Nurtec ODT quantity limit authorization that took effect within the last 12 months together with at least 3 paid retail fills of Nurtec ODT dated within the last three months adds 2 units; such an authorization with fewer than 3 such fills, or at least one such fill without such an authorization, adds 1 unit; neither adds nothing.

- The authorization is any quantity limit authorization for Nurtec ODT under the Utilization Management Program whose effective date falls within the last 12 months.
- The fills are paid retail claims for Nurtec ODT under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, counted one by one (the number of fills, not their quantity).
- Windows end on the decision date: a record is within the last N months when dated after the same day of the month N months before the decision date.

## Combinations

| Nurtec ODT quantity limit authorization effective within 12 months | Paid Nurtec ODT retail fills within 3 months | Units added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3 or more | 2 |
| Yes | 1 or 2 | 1 |
| Yes | 0 | 1 |
| No | 1 or more | 1 |
| No | 0 | 0 |

### Hypothetical cases

- A member with a Nurtec ODT quantity limit authorization effective 5 months before the decision and 3 paid Nurtec ODT fills in the last three months: 2 units.
- A member with no such authorization and 4 paid Nurtec ODT fills in the last three months: 1 unit.
- The allowance reads Nurtec ODT records whichever acute migraine drug the exception concerns.
